title: Week 5 Recap
body:
Greetings fellow Dads,

Five weeks in and I've learned two things. Nobody in this league knows how to set a lineup. And the commissioner is somehow 4-1.

Let's get into it.

## The Games

**Niko Dadfield 188.30, White Pollard 145.70**
The best team in the league did best-team-in-the-league things again. Jaylen Warren put up 36.8, which I would not have predicted in any universe. Bowers added 23. That's four straight wins and the week's high score. Jas got 37.7 from Gibbs and still lost by 42. That has to sting. Niko's one mistake all week was his parlay leg: St. Brown to score. He started St. Brown too, and got 12.9 points and no touchdown. So close to perfect.

**Drake Baker 182.66, Nacuas With Attitude 180.16**
Game of the week. Mike put up 180.16, the most points anyone has scored in a loss this season. He'd have beaten seven teams. Puka went for 37.7, Nabers for 29.1. Then the Steelers D/ST scored one point, and that was that. Baker won on 39.5 from Drake Maye and 32.4 from Isaiah Likely, with Justin Jefferson's 18.8 sitting on his bench. He benched Justin Jefferson and won anyway. Baker is also now 5-for-5 on parlay picks. The man can't miss. Ask him for lottery numbers.

Small mercy for Mike: Brissett 250+ finally cashed. That's his first parlay hit of the season. Baby steps.

**Jaxon Smith My Njigba 173.20, Aborted Conception 127.68**
The biggest blowout of the week, at +45.52. Christian Watson for 32.3 and Josh Allen for 30.5. Kool got 1.1 from David Montgomery and didn't need him. Schmuke is still 4-1, but he slid from 3rd to 5th in the power rankings because the scoring isn't keeping up with the record. His Jaguars D/ST scored 4. His parlay under missed too. Rough day at the office.

**ILoveTeeSwift 139.76, BrekinBonez Jonez 138.24**
Lost by 1.52. Jones started CeeDee Lamb (2.9) over Keenan Allen (9.5), who sat on his bench. That's a 6.6-point swing in a 1.52-point loss. Do the math. Actually, don't. It'll ruin your week. Andrew left 27.3 from Stafford on his own bench and won anyway, so he jumps three spots to #2. Some guys are just lucky. Meanwhile Jones is 4-for-5 on parlay picks and 1-4 in fantasy. He can pick NFL games. He cannot pick his own lineup.

**Waddle you doing, step-Bo? 98.54, Gloria Hole 92.32**
The ugliest game of the season, and I was in it. My Cowboys D/ST scored *negative two*. Romeo Doubs gave me 2.6 while Blake Corum put up 16.2 on my bench. I won with a 98.54, which would have beaten exactly one team this week. That team was my opponent. You don't get to pick your schedule, but if you could, I'd pick this one. Breezy got 31.5 from Bucky Irving and 0.7 from RJ Harvey at flex. That's the week's low score and three straight losses. Hang in there, buddy. Or don't. Your call.

## Power Rankings (The Short Version)

1. **Niko Dadfield (4-1)**: The best team in the league, and the scoring backs it up.
2. **ILoveTeeSwift (3-2), up 3**: Won by 1.52 with Stafford on the bench. We'll take it.
3. **Drake Baker (2-3), up 3**: Has the most points against in the league, so the record is lying.
4. **Jaxon Smith My Njigba (3-2)**: Second-best all-play record. Quietly dangerous.
5. **Aborted Conception (4-1), down 2**: The record is ahead of the scoring. Watch out.
6. **Waddle you doing, step-Bo? (4-1), down 4**: The math says I'm a fraud. The math is right.
7. **Nacuas With Attitude (2-3), up 2**: Scored 180 and lost. Brutal.
8. **White Pollard (1-4)**: Gibbs can't do it alone.
9. **BrekinBonez Jonez (1-4), up 1**: Keenan Allen, buddy. *Keenan Allen.*
10. **Gloria Hole (1-4), down 3**: All-play record of 10-35. That's not bad luck.

## Parlay Corner

Three of ten. We're 0-5 on the season. Seven of us missed, and the only ones who didn't were Baker, Mike and Jones. At this point the parlay is a weekly donation to whatever sportsbook we're keeping in business.

## Week 6: The One to Watch

Niko Dadfield vs. Waddle you doing, step-Bo? Two 4-1 teams. One is the best team in the league. The other is me. Place your bets. Actually, given our track record, please don't.

MattyMo

title: Week 6 Recap
body:
Greetings fellow Dads,

Last week I called myself a fraud. This week I scored 171.14. I'm still a fraud. I'm just a 5-1 fraud with the most points of the week.

Let's get into it.

## The Games

**Waddle you doing, step-Bo? 171.14, Niko Dadfield 86.48**
The best team in the league showed up and then didn't. Jameis Winston gave Niko 6.48. Terry McLaurin gave him 3.7. His best player was Dameon Pierce, at 15. That's the week's low score, and it would have lost to all nine teams. Meanwhile Christian McCaffrey dropped 30.7 on him and Kenneth Walker added 27.9. Biggest blowout of the season so far: +84.66. The funny part? Niko's parlay leg was CMC anytime TD. It hit. He bet on my running back to score against him, and my running back obliged. That's called hedging. My worst starter, for the record, was Jaylen Waddle at 6.4. The guy my team is named after. Loyalty is a one-way street.

**Drake Baker 140.90, Jaxon Smith My Njigba 101.30**
James Cook put up 24.3 and Isaiah Likely added 23.9. That's three straight wins for Baker, and the second-best score of the week. Kuhlman got 25.4 from the guy on his team name and 18.3 from Josh Allen, then started Brandon Aubrey (1.0) and Juwan Johnson (0.0). Colston Loveland put up 18.5 on his bench. It wouldn't have saved him. It just would have been less embarrassing. In bigger news: Baker finally missed a parlay leg. Watson 71.5 receiving yards. Christian Watson plays for Kuhlman, and he gave him 9.4. Baker is now 5-for-6. The streak is dead. Nobody tell him.

**ILoveTeeSwift 130.88, White Pollard 98.64**
D'Andre Swift went for 23. Team name pays off. Last week Andrew left Stafford's 27.3 on the bench. This week he started Stafford, who scored 16.88, and left Jayden Daniels on the bench for 21. He cannot win this game. He keeps winning the other one, though. Bijan Robinson gave him 7.3. Still won by 32.24. Jas got 19.84 from Bryce Young, which is a sentence I never expected to type, then 0.0 from Quinshon Judkins at flex. Pollard, the man on the team name, gave him 7.6. Two straight losses, 1-5. Herbert to throw a touchdown missed too. Rough stretch.

**Nacuas With Attitude 127.18, BrekinBonez Jonez 123.14**
Closest game of the week, at 4.04. Malik Nabers went for 28.5 and Bhayshul Tuten added 24.7. Mike survived a zero from Tyler Warren at tight end. Jones did everything right this time. He started Keenan Allen, who gave him 16.2. Trevor Lawrence put up 27.34. Then the Texans D/ST scored *negative two*. He lost by 4.04. His 123.14 is the most points in a loss this week, and it would have beaten five teams. Three straight losses. Jones also had Josh Allen to score, and Josh Allen didn't. At least Mike can relate. His Bowers 7+ receptions missed, and he's 1-for-6 on the season.

**Aborted Conception 113.52, Gloria Hole 99.22**
Matthew Golden put up 22.4 and Jonathan Taylor added 21.1. Schmuke got a zero from Cam Skattebo at flex and 2 from the Rams D/ST and still won by 14.3. That's 5-1. The record keeps outrunning the points. Breezy got 20.5 from DeVonta Smith and 20.3 from DK Metcalf, then 3.4 from Kenny Gainwell and 1 from the Eagles D/ST. Michael Mayer scored 16.5 on his bench while Travis Kelce scored 9.3 in his lineup. My parlay leg was Kelce 4+ receptions. It hit. So Kelce helped one of us this week, and it wasn't Breezy. Breezy's own leg was Bucky Irving to score. Irving started for him, scored 6.9, and didn't find the end zone. Four straight losses. All-play record of 12-42. Hang in there, buddy.

## Power Rankings (The Short Version)

1. **Drake Baker (3-3), up 2**: .500 record, best recent form in the league. The math loves him. The math has never watched him set a lineup.
2. **ILoveTeeSwift (4-2)**: Keeps benching the wrong quarterback. Keeps winning.
3. **Niko Dadfield (4-2), down 2**: One bad week. A very, very bad week.
4. **Waddle you doing, step-Bo? (5-1), up 2**: Tied for first in the standings, fourth here. I've stopped arguing with the formula.
5. **Aborted Conception (5-1)**: Also 5-1. Also not getting any respect. All-play record of 28-26.
6. **Nacuas With Attitude (3-3), up 1**: Back to .500. Nabers is carrying this team on his back.
7. **Jaxon Smith My Njigba (3-3), down 3**: All-play record of 35-19, tied for second-best in the league. Lost by 39.6 anyway.
8. **White Pollard (1-5)**: Bryce Young was the best player on the roster this week. Let that sink in.
9. **BrekinBonez Jonez (1-5)**: Finally started Keenan Allen. The defense scored negative two. Can't win.
10. **Gloria Hole (1-5)**: Four straight losses. The scoring isn't close.

## Parlay Corner

Four of ten. We're 0-6 on the season. The hits: me, Schmuke, Andrew and Niko. Two of those four were my running backs. Schmuke had Walker 90+ rushing yards and Niko had CMC to score. I'm thinking about charging a licensing fee. Baker's perfect run is over. Mike is 1-for-6. Someone please lend Mike a coin to flip.

## Week 7: The One to Watch

Waddle you doing, step-Bo? vs. ILoveTeeSwift. I'm 5-1 and ranked fourth. Andrew is 4-2 and ranked second. If he starts the right quarterback, I'm in trouble. History says he won't. Also worth a look: Aborted Conception (5-1) vs. Niko Dadfield (4-2). Schmuke's record against a guy who just scored 86.48 and is mad about it.

MattyMo

title: Week 7 Preview: The Sunday Rundown
body:
Let me tell you something, Dads. Week 7 is HERE, the Steelers and Saints kick it off in London at 8:30 Central, and I have looked at these lineups one last time, and I am DISGUSTED.

Bears beat the Patriots 30-24 on Thursday night, so some of you already have points in the bank. Others have a goose egg and a prayer. And THREE of you are starting players projected for ZERO. Three! We'll get there. Oh, we will GET there.

## The Card

**Gloria Hole (1-5) vs. Jaxon Smith My Njigba (3-3)**
Breezy has lost FOUR in a row. Last in points, last in power, last in all-play at 12-42. So what does a man in that position do? He benches Ja'Marr Chase (projected 21.79) and Chase Brown (14.74), then puts DeVonta Smith at flex, projected for ZERO. ESPN has Gloria Hole at 98.71, lowest in the league. Kuhlman's squad is at 147.54 with 19.9 already banked from Colston Loveland on Thursday. Josh Allen's Bills are on bye, so it's Brock Purdy (20.43) under center. Down 48.83 on paper. It is OVER. It was over when the lineup locked.

**Drake Baker (3-3) vs. BrekinBonez Jonez (1-5)**
Baker is No. 1 in my power rankings, first in the league in points for (862.92), riding a three-game win streak, and already sitting on 51.14 before anybody else woke up. Drake Maye put up 27.44, Luther Burden added 23.7, and he left Caleb Williams' 22.12 on the BENCH and still made the right call. Projected 163.54, highest in the league. Now Jones. Jones has lost three straight. Jones has Saquon Barkley (15.19) and Josh Jacobs (12.64) on his bench while Kendre Miller (9.35) starts at RB and Keenan Allen (8.95) sits at flex. WHY?! Projected 122.54, down 41 with zero banked. Somebody check on this man's lineup screen.

**Aborted Conception (5-1) vs. Niko Dadfield (4-2)**
THIS one got interesting. Lamar Jackson is projected for zero this week, so Schmuke benched him and is rolling with Tyler Shough (15.3). That's the correct move, and I can't believe I'm saying it. Rhamondre Stevenson already put 22.5 in the bank Thursday, and Matthew Golden (16.89) and Trey McBride (15.85) lead the rest of the way to 141.02. Niko is coming off an 86.48 faceplant, but he's still 36-18 in all-play, best in the league. Amon-Ra St. Brown (19.5), Aaron Rodgers (19.46) and Brock Bowers (18.46) project him to 138.96. Down 2.06 with a full Sunday to play. That's not a deficit, that's a dare.

**Nacuas With Attitude (3-3) vs. White Pollard ✊🏻 (1-5)**
Mike has 15.4 banked: Hunter Henry gave him 14.1, and Roschon Johnson gave him... 1.3, while TreVeyon Henderson scored 4.3 on his BENCH. And it gets WORSE. Puka Nacua, the man on the team name, is at flex, projected for ZERO. The team is projected at 100.44, ninth in the league this week. Jas has 18.7 in the bank from A.J. Brown (7.8) and Rome Odunze (10.9), and Jahmyr Gibbs is projected for 26, the biggest number on ANY roster. White Pollard projects to 136.94, up 36.5. Jas is 1-5. This is the week. If not now, WHEN?

**Waddle you doing, step-Bo? (5-1) vs. ILoveTeeSwift (4-2)**
Projected 138.24 to 138.12. TWELVE HUNDREDTHS of a point. And Andrew is STILL starting Cam Little at kicker, with the Jaguars ON BYE. Projected zero, in a game projected to be decided by 0.12. D'Andre Swift already handed him 19 on Thursday (team name paying off AGAIN), so he leads 19 to 5.3 in the bank. MattyMo got 5.3 from DeMario Douglas and has Christian McCaffrey (21.92), Jordan Love (19.62) and Kenneth Walker (19.1) still to go. Bijan Robinson (21.15) and C.J. Stroud (19.5) carry Andrew's side. Andrew, kickoff is coming. FIX IT.

## Game of the Week

Waddle you doing, step-Bo? against ILoveTeeSwift. 5-1 against 4-2, both on two-game win streaks, No. 4 and No. 2 in the power rankings, separated by 0.12 projected points. And one side has a kicker on bye. Honorable mention to Aborted Conception vs. Niko Dadfield at 2.06. Two coin flips on one Sunday. I can't take it.

## Parlay Watch

ALL TEN legs are in. Finally. Approx. lines are from VegasInsider as of Saturday afternoon. A couple of the spread picks got the hook, a half point better than the current market, so I'm showing where the market sits rather than guessing a price. The player props don't have a line I could find. Ranked safest to longest among the priced legs:

1. **Baker: Panthers ML (approx. -155).** LOCK. The man went 5-for-6 to start the season and he's backing the home favorite with his own Tetairoa McMillan on the field.
2. **Breezy: Giants +10.5 (market approx. Giants +10 at -105).** LOCK. Breezy benched Ja'Marr Chase, but THIS he got right, and he's got the hook on top. Every Giants yard is a yard Woody Marks and Kuhlman don't get.
3. **Kuhlman: Raiders +3.5 (market approx. Raiders +3 at -102).** LOCK. Taking the points at home, with the half point over the number. Boring, but respectable.
4. **Niko: Chiefs ML (approx. +124).** STAY AWAY. Chiefs on the road in Seattle, Sunday night, as the underdog. That's your LONGSHOT OF THE WEEK, and it's the last leg on the card to settle. Nine other legs, all waiting on Niko.
5. **Andrew: Germie Bernard 50+ receiving yards (no line found).** LOCK. His own flex, in the London game, so we'll know by lunch. The ONE smart thing Andrew did this week. Enjoy it, because the Wall of Shame is coming.
6. **Jones: Brock Purdy 200+ passing yards (no line found).** LOCK. Took him long enough to turn it in, but 200 is a low bar. Purdy plays for Kuhlman, not Baker, so no conflict there.
7. **MattyMo: Denzel Boston TD (no line found).** STAY AWAY. A touchdown prop on a guy projected for 11.98 fantasy points. Hope is not a strategy, MattyMo.
8. **Schmuke: Jordan Love 280+ pass yards (no line found).** STAY AWAY. 280 in Detroit? That's MattyMo's quarterback, by the way. Schmuke is now financially invested in MattyMo having a good day.
9. **Mike: Chris Olave 75+ receiving yards (no line found).** WHAT ARE WE DOING. Mike is STARTING the Steelers D/ST against the Saints. He needs Olave to torch his own defense. One hit all season and he's betting against himself.
10. **Jas: Patrick Mahomes 200+ pass yards (no line found).** WHAT ARE WE DOING. Jas plays Mike this week. Mike's quarterback? Patrick Mahomes. Jas is rooting for his OPPONENT'S QB.

## Wall of Shame

**Starting a zero.** THREE of you.

**Andrew.** Cam Little. Kicker. Jaguars ON BYE. Projected 0.00. Every other kicker in this league is projected for at least 8.15, and you're in a game projected to be decided by 0.12. Do you understand what that means? ANY kicker wins you this game on paper. Your parlay leg got in. Your lineup didn't get looked at. That's not a bad week, that's a choice.

**Mike.** Puka Nacua at flex, projected for ZERO. The guy your TEAM IS NAMED AFTER, sitting in your lineup as a blank space, while Courtland Sutton (8.93) sits on your bench. Your team is projected at 100.44. You're already down 36.5. And you're going to hand Jas a free flex spot on top of it? Fix it, Mike!

**Breezy.** DeVonta Smith at flex, projected for ZERO, with Ja'Marr Chase (21.79) and Chase Brown (14.74) on the bench. Four straight losses, dead last in the league, and you're playing with nine men. I have NO WORDS. Actually I have plenty, and they're all in this paragraph.

All three of you: kickoff is 8:30 Central in London, and every one of these slots is still fixable before your guys play. NO EXCUSES.

**No pick.** Nobody. All ten legs are in. Andrew and Jones made it under the wire. Jones, congratulations: you made it off the wall. Andrew, you got off one wall and stayed on the other.

## Fraud Alert

**Aborted Conception.** 5-1. Tied for the best record in the league. And sixth in points for at 781.98. In all-play they're 28-26, barely above .500. Their last three weeks average 127.53, while 3-3 Jaxon Smith My Njigba has outscored them by 62.74 points on the season and sits second in the league in points for. One team is getting the breaks. The other is getting the bill. And this week Schmuke is starting Tyler Shough over Lamar Jackson. Schmuke, enjoy the record. The math is coming for you.

Big Dad Energy

title: Week 7 Recap
body:
Greetings fellow Dads,

WHAT. A. WEEK. Two games decided by a combined 4.68 points! A defense that scored *negative six* and decided a game by itself! A parlay that went 2-for-10! Grab the remote, crank the volume and pull up the recliner, because Week 7 had EVERYTHING. Let's go to the tape!

## The Games

**ILoveTeeSwift 122.32, Waddle you doing, step-Bo? 116.26**
We start with the biggest bonehead in the building, and folks, it's ME. Lost by 6.06! Cam "Skate or Die" Skattebo is rolling down the sideline on my BENCH for 19.1 points! And who's in my flex? Jaylen "Waddle I Do Now" Waddle with 8.8 and Kenneth "Walker, Texas Ranger" Walker with 9.7! Swap Skattebo for Waddle and I win by 4.24! The man my TEAM IS NAMED AFTER sinks the ship! Jared "Goff the Bench" Goff piles on with 18.02 in reserve while Jordan "Love Me Tender" Love starts and goes for 16.96. And the Chiefs D/ST? *Negative one!* On the other side, Andrew's in full bloom. Zay "Bloom Where You're Planted" Flowers goes for 27.7, Tee "FORE!" Higgins chips in 26.8, and Ryan "Fits and Starts" Fitzgerald, the kicker Andrew finally picked up, boots home a mighty 1 point. ONE! Which is one more than the bye-week guy he was starting on Saturday! Andrew is 5-2, winner of three straight. I'm 5-2, beaten by the guy who almost started a kicker on vacation. Nobody feels worse about it than me.

**Jaxon Smith My Njigba 111.52, Gloria Hole 110.88**
Photo finish! Closest game of the week, by 0.64! And Breezy did everything RIGHT! Ja'Marr "Paper" Chase is back in the lineup with 17.2! Bucky "Bucket List" Irving dashes for 24! Dak "Back to the Future" Prescott slings 23.28! He's at the 40, the 30, the 20, he's got the win in his sights... and here come the Eagles D/ST, "The Eagle Has Crash-Landed," with NEGATIVE SIX! Breezy loses by 0.64! Any defense in America that scored better than -5.36 wins him this game! ANY DEFENSE! Ten dads in jean shorts win him this game! Five straight losses, 1-6, heartbreak city. Kuhlman got 31.3 from Jaxon "Smith and Wesson" Smith-Njigba, the man on the marquee, and won it while the Seahawks D/ST (9) sat on his bench and the Browns D/ST (5) started. Kuhlman left points on the pine and WON. Breezy started a defense and LOST. Football, everybody!

**BrekinBonez Jonez 126.68, Drake Baker 122.64**
UPSET ALERT! ESPN had Baker at 163.54 going into Sunday, highest in the league, a runaway train! He finishes at 122.64! Isaiah "Highly Unlikely" Likely puts up 3.2 at tight end while Harold "Fan Favorite" Fannin piles up 13.1 on the BENCH. That's a 9.9-point swing in a 4.04-point loss! Dominic "Zvada Doo" Zvada kicks in 1 point! The Titans D/ST? Zero! The No. 1 power team, taken down by his own kicker, defense and tight end! And Jones, losers of three straight, rises from the ashes! Bo "Nix at Nite" Nix lights it up for 26.18! Jameson "On the Rocks" Williams pours in 26.1! CeeDee "Lamb Chop" Lamb serves up 24.4! He STILL left Josh "Jacob's Ladder" Jacobs' 20.1 on the bench and started Kendre Miller (5.8). Doesn't matter! Jones snaps the skid! Party in the BrekinBonez basement!

**Niko Dadfield 152.08, Aborted Conception 126.92**
High score of the week and it's a team effort! Amon-Ra "Here Comes the Sun God" St. Brown, 24.2! Tre "Tuckered Out" Tucker, 21.3! Braelon "Allen Wrench" Allen tightens it up with 19.4! Emanuel "Wilson the Volleyball" Wilson bumps, sets and spikes 18.5! Aaron Jones gave him 3.6 and nobody even noticed. Schmuke got 27.1 from Trey "Here Comes the" McBride and 22.5 from Rhamondre "Rocket" Stevenson, and then the Panthers D/ST went for -3 and Denzel "Training Day" Boston clocked out at 5.7. His 126.92 was the most points in a loss this week. The Sunday Rundown called Schmuke a fraud on Saturday. The math came due on Sunday.

**White Pollard ✊🏻 149.08, Nacuas With Attitude 105**
BLOWOUT! Biggest of the week, by 44.08! ALL ABOARD the Tony "Pollard Express" Pollard! The man on the team name goes for 36.5 out of the flex, the best starter in the ENTIRE LEAGUE this week! Joe "Burrow Down Deep" Burrow adds 28.88! Jas left Quinshon Judkins' 23.4 on the bench and STILL won by 44! Mike fixed his Puka problem, and Puka "Shell Game" Nacua delivered 21.8. Then Patrick "Mahomes Alone" Mahomes gave him 6. SIX! Low score of the week, 105. And here's the kicker, and it's not Fitzgerald: Jas's parlay leg was Mahomes 200+ passing yards. It MISSED. Jas bet on his opponent's quarterback, lost the bet, and won the game BECAUSE of it! Hedge of the year! By accident!

## Power Rankings (The Short Version)

1. **Niko Dadfield (5-2), up 2.** Most points in the league (989.28)! Best all-play record (45-18)! The Dadfield Dynasty rolls on!
2. **Drake Baker (3-4), down 1.** Second in points, 3-4 in real life. Somebody fire the tight end coach!
3. **ILoveTeeSwift (5-2), down 1.** Three straight wins AND a kicker with a pulse. Growth!
4. **Waddle you doing, step-Bo? (5-2), no change.** Benched the winning points. Named the team after the losing ones. Waddle I do now?
5. **Jaxon Smith My Njigba (4-3), up 2.** Won by 0.64 with the better defense on the bench. Lucky? Sure. Fourth in points? Also sure.
6. **Aborted Conception (5-2), down 1.** The record says contender. Sixth in points says pump the brakes!
7. **Nacuas With Attitude (3-4), down 1.** Low score of the week. Mahomes Alone, and Mike's alone with him.
8. **White Pollard ✊🏻 (2-5), no change.** 149.08 and a 44-point beatdown! Is the Pollard Express leaving the station?
9. **BrekinBonez Jonez (2-5), no change.** Losing streak OVER! Lineup decisions still under review in New York.
10. **Gloria Hole (1-6), no change.** Five straight losses. The last one by a defense. Ouch.

## Parlay Corner

TWO HITS! Two! Out of TEN! Worst week of the season, and it's not even close. The previous low was 3, in Week 5. This parlay didn't just miss, it fell down the stairs.

The survivors: Breezy's Giants +10.5 (lost by a defense, won his bet, a roller coaster of a Sunday) and Jones's Brock "Purdy Good" Purdy 200+ yards. That puts Jones at 5-for-7 on the season, tied with Baker for the best mark in the league!

The carnage: my Denzel Boston TD? Missed. Baker's Panthers ML? Missed, two misses in two weeks after a 5-for-5 start! Niko's Chiefs ML? Missed! Mike's Chris "Olive Garden" Olave 75+? Missed, and Mike's breadsticks are getting cold at 1 hit in 7 weeks. And Andrew's Germie "Lost in Translation" Bernard 50+ receiving yards in LONDON? Missed, with 5.7 fantasy points thrown in for good measure.

Lesson of the week, in big bold letters: **STAY AWAY FROM THE INTERNATIONAL GAMES!** Different time zone, different continent, same result. MISS!

## Week 8: The One to Watch

**ILoveTeeSwift (5-2) vs. Aborted Conception (5-2).** Clash of the 5-2s! Andrew rides a three-game win streak and sits No. 3 in power. Schmuke just took his second loss and sits sixth in points. One of them walks out 6-2. The other walks out with questions. Andrew, buddy, pal: CHECK. YOUR. KICKER.

MattyMo

title: Week 8 Preview: The Sunday Rundown
body:
Well, here we are, Dads. Week 8. Football Sunday. And you know what makes a football Sunday? Football! The early games kick off at noon Central, the big guys are putting their hands in the dirt, and somewhere a man is starting a kicker whose team isn't even PLAYING. We'll get to that. Oh, boy, will we get to that.

Packers beat the Panthers 27-19 on Thursday night, so a few of you already have points in the bank. And three of you are starting players projected for ZERO. One of you is doing it TWICE. That's not a lineup, that's a hole in the line, and if I'm drawing it up on the telestrator, the whole defense is running right through it. WHAM!

## The Card

**Jaxon Smith My Njigba (4-3) vs. BrekinBonez Jonez (2-5)**
Now here's a matchup with a little something in it. Kuhlman banked 26.9 on Thursday, Christian Watson with 17.3 and Jalen Coker with 9.6. Jones answered with one guy, Josh Jacobs, and Josh Jacobs went BOOM for 23.2. Kuhlman leads 26.9 to 23.2 in the bank. But Jones is projected to finish at 149.37 against Kuhlman's 143.92, so on paper Jones wins by 5.45. CeeDee Lamb (20.06), Javonte Williams (20.11) and Trevor Lawrence (20.85) do the heavy lifting for Jones. Josh Allen (23.7) and Jaxon Smith-Njigba (21.47) carry Kuhlman. Jones is ninth in my power rankings and has won exactly one game in a row. He's projected to make it two. I don't believe it either.

**Niko Dadfield (5-2) vs. Gloria Hole (1-6)**
Niko is No. 1 in my power rankings. 45-18 in all-play, best in the league, first in points for at 989.28. Projected 130.01, with Braelon Allen (17.22), Amon-Ra St. Brown (17.8) and Brock Bowers (16.15) leading the way. And on the other side... Breezy. FIVE straight losses. Last in points, last in power, 13-50 in all-play. Projected 113.43, and that's with TWO starters projected for zero. Down 16.58 on paper. Breezy, I've seen a lot of football. I have never seen a man fight with nine guys on purpose. Twice in two weeks. DOINK.

**White Pollard ✊🏻 (2-5) vs. Drake Baker (3-4)**
Jas leads in the bank, 17.3 to 11.8. Tucker Kraft put up 17.3 on Thursday, and here's a guy who just goes out there and catches the football. Tetairoa McMillan got Baker 11.8. Baker is No. 2 in my power rankings with a losing record, second in the league in points for at 985.56, and he's projected at 148.83 with Drake Maye (22.44) and James Cook (18.82) leading the charge. Jas is projected at 139.03 with Jahmyr Gibbs at 24.59, the biggest number on any roster this week. Down 9.8 on paper. But Jas is starting a zero at wide receiver, and if he fixes it, this thing is down to half a point. Half a point! Somebody get Jas a phone.

**ILoveTeeSwift (5-2) vs. Aborted Conception (5-2)**
Two 5-2 teams, and one of them already has a giant head start. Schmuke banked 45.8 on Thursday, the biggest early lead on the board: Chuba Hubbard 24.9, Matthew Golden 20.9. Andrew has zero in the bank and a three-game win streak on the line. Schmuke projects to 146.00, Andrew to 135.71, so Schmuke is up 10.29 on paper... while starting Breece Hall at flex, projected for ZERO. Lamar Jackson is back under center for Schmuke (22.15), Bijan Robinson (20.28) and Zay Flowers (20.14) carry Andrew. Andrew, you need a big day. A turkey-leg, gravy-on-everything kind of day.

**Waddle you doing, step-Bo? (5-2) vs. Nacuas With Attitude (3-4)**
Nobody's played yet in this one. Nothing in the bank on either side. MattyMo projects to 122.90, Mike to 120.79. That's 2.11 points. The closest game on the card. Jayden Daniels (22.8) and Kenneth Walker (19.85) for MattyMo, Puka Nacua (22.8), actually projected for points this week, for Mike, with Bhayshul Tuten (14.72) and Patrick Mahomes (14.23). Two teams, one coin, and a whole lot of Sunday.

## Early Leads

**Schmuke** leads Andrew 45.8 to 0. Hubbard and Golden did that on a Thursday night in Green Bay. That's the biggest head start in the league, and I love a big head start. But Schmuke, it's a long Sunday, and you're carrying a zero at flex.

**Jas** leads Baker 17.3 to 11.8, up 5.5. Kraft beat McMillan. Enjoy it, Jas. Baker still has Maye, Cook, Jefferson and London to go.

**Kuhlman** leads Jones 26.9 to 23.2, up 3.7, with Watson and Coker against Jacobs. And Jones is projected to pass him. Kuhlman, don't get comfortable.

Niko vs. Breezy and MattyMo vs. Mike are both 0 to 0. Everybody starts at the same line of scrimmage.

## Matchups to Watch

1. **Waddle you doing, step-Bo? vs. Nacuas With Attitude.** 2.11 projected points. Nothing banked. Pure Sunday football.
2. **Jaxon Smith My Njigba vs. BrekinBonez Jonez.** Kuhlman up 3.7 in the bank, Jones up 5.45 in projection. And look at this: Kuhlman took the Jags moneyline, and Jones starts the Jags' quarterback. Jones took the Bills moneyline, and Kuhlman starts the Bills' quarterback. These two are betting on each other's guys. I love it. I don't understand it, but I love it.
3. **White Pollard ✊🏻 vs. Drake Baker.** Down 9.8 as it stands. Down 0.53 if Jas wakes up and benches the zero. That's the swingiest lineup decision in the league this morning.

## Parlay Watch

ALL TEN legs are in. Approx. moneylines are DraftKings via ESPN as of Sunday morning. No lines found for the player props, so no odds on those and no $10 payout this week. Ranked safest to longest among the priced legs:

1. **Jas: Bengals ML (approx. -950).** LOCK. Bengals by 13.5 at home against Tennessee, and Jas starts Joe Burrow, so the leg and the lineup are pulling the same sled. One small thing: Tony Pollard is in Jas's flex, and he plays for the Titans. Jas is rooting against his own flex. Minor. But I saw it.
2. **Kuhlman: Jags ML (approx. -500).** LOCK on the board, shaky in the standings. The Jags are 10-point favorites over the Colts. But Trevor Lawrence is Jones's quarterback, and Jones is Kuhlman's opponent this week. Kuhlman is betting on his opponent's QB.
3. **Jones: Bills ML (approx. -162).** STAY AWAY. Same deal, reversed. Kuhlman starts Josh Allen. Jones needs the Bills to win, which means Jones needs Josh Allen to have a nice day, which means Jones needs his OPPONENT to have a nice day. And that's the pick he settled on AFTER he tried to submit a Denver Broncos moneyline. Against the Kansas City Chiefs. Everybody in this league's team. Hold on, I need to draw this up. Here's the Chiefs. Here's all ten of us. And here's Jones, way over on the other sideline, with an arrow pointing at Denver. WHAT ARE WE DOING, Jones? You don't bet against the family. That's football 101. That's the first page of the book.
4. **Niko: Chiefs ML (approx. -115).** LOCK. The longest priced leg of the week, and it's still a road favorite in Denver. That's how you back the team: with conviction. Niko, take notes for Jones.
5. **Andrew: Diggs 4+ receptions (no line found).** LOCK. His own starting wide receiver. Simple football: you start him, you bet him, you root for him. Everybody's going the same direction.
6. **Breezy: Walker TD (no line found).** LOCK. Kenneth Walker plays for the Chiefs, so Breezy is rooting for the family. He's also rooting for MattyMo's running back, but MattyMo isn't his opponent, so I'll allow it. The one thing Breezy did right all week.
7. **Mike: Lawrence 200+ pass yards (no line found).** LOCK. Mike's own Bhayshul Tuten plays in that game, and Lawrence isn't on MattyMo's roster. No conflicts. Look at Mike, thinking.
8. **MattyMo: Irving 3+ receptions (no line found).** STAY AWAY. A receptions prop on a running back. That's Breezy's running back, by the way. Nobody's got a stake in it but MattyMo.
9. **Baker: Hockenson 37.5+ receiving yards (no line found).** STAY AWAY. A hook on a tight end's yardage. That's MattyMo's tight end. Baker plays Jas, so no conflict, just hope.
10. **Schmuke: Brown 81.5+ total yards (no line found).** WHAT ARE WE DOING. WHICH Brown? If it's Chase Brown, fine, he's projected for 16.94 fantasy points. If it's A.J. Brown, ESPN has him projected for zero this week. Schmuke, write the first name down next time. It's the least you can do.

**Shaky bets:** Jones (Bills ML, his opponent's QB) and Kuhlman (Jags ML, his opponent's QB) are betting on each other. Jas is quietly rooting against his own flex. And Jones TRIED to bet against the Chiefs. No international games this week, and no long underdogs on the card.

## Wall of Shame

**Starting a zero.** THREE of you, and FOUR zeros. Kickoff is noon Central. Every one of these is fixable right now.

**Breezy.** Two zeros. TWO. RJ Harvey at flex, projected for zero, with Rashee Rice (12.65) sitting right there on your bench. And Eddy Pineiro at kicker, and the 49ers are ON BYE. Every other starting kicker in this league is projected for at least 8.88. You're down 16.58 on paper. Put Rice in and you're down 3.93. Find a kicker who's projected like the worst kicker in this league and you're AHEAD. Five straight losses, 1-6, and the way out is sitting on your bench. Last week it was DeVonta Smith in the flex. This week it's two of them. Breezy, I'm laughing, but I'm not happy about it.

**Jas.** A.J. Brown at wide receiver, projected for zero. Rome Odunze is on your bench at 9.27. You're down 9.8 to Baker. With Odunze you're down 0.53. Half a point, Jas! You've got a 5.5-point lead in the bank and a 2-5 record, and you're about to hand away the closest thing you've had to a sure thing all year. FIX IT.

**Schmuke.** Breece Hall at flex, projected for zero. Malik Washington (10.26), Jordan Addison (9.79) and Caleb Douglas (9.15) are all on your bench. You're up 10.29 with the zero, 20.55 without it. You can afford it, sure. But that's how a man gets burned. Put somebody in there.

**No pick.** Nobody. All ten legs are in. But we're putting **Jones** up here anyway. Jones tried to submit a Denver Broncos moneyline. Against the Kansas City Chiefs. The team ALL TEN OF US root for. Jones is 2-5, ninth in power, 22-41 in all-play, and his big idea this week was to bet against the one thing this league agrees on. Then he went with the Bills, which means rooting for the quarterback of the guy he's playing. Jones, the Broncos pick never made it to the card, but it made it to the Wall. That's a pick for the ages, and not the good kind of ages.

## Fraud Alert

**Aborted Conception.** Repeat offender. 5-2, tied for the best record in the league, and sixth in points for at 908.90. In all-play they're 35-28. Their last three weeks average 122.71, ninth in the league. Meanwhile Baker is 3-4 with 985.56 points, 76.66 more than Schmuke, and second in the power rankings. One of these teams is getting the breaks and one is getting the bill. And this week Schmuke has a 45.8-point head start and a zero at flex. Schmuke, enjoy the record. The math is still coming for you.

Big Dad Energy

title: Week 8 Recap
body:
Greetings fellow Dads,

Eight weeks in. Before anything else: Mike had a baby boy. Congratulations to Mike and his family. Somewhere out there is a future league member. He'll be setting a better lineup than his father by age six.

Now the bad news. I'm 6-2 and first in the power rankings. I won by 0.64 points, and I had 25.3 on my bench. Nobody is more surprised than me.

Let's get into it.

## The Games

**White Pollard 174.78, Drake Baker 129.56**
High score of the week, and the biggest blowout at +45.22. Joe Burrow put up 39.48. Tony Pollard, the man on the team name, added 28.7. Jas also fixed the zero at wide receiver and started Rome Odunze, who gave him 12.7. Listening. In this league. Two straight wins. His Bengals moneyline hit too. It was the safest leg on the card at about -950, and the Titans still put up 36 points while Cam Ward threw for 304, his first 300-yard game. They lost anyway. A lock is a lock. Baker got 22.46 from Drake Maye, then 2.6 from Kyle Pitts and 1.8 from Drake London. Harold Fannin put up 23.4 on his bench. It wouldn't have saved him. Two straight losses. His Hockenson 37.5+ receiving yards leg hit. Baker is now 6-for-8 on the season. Still can't set a lineup.

**Gloria Hole 154.20, Niko Dadfield 127.28**
Breezy won. I'll say it again. Breezy won. Five straight losses, over. Ja'Marr Chase went for 31.1 and Michael Wilson for 26.8. Second-highest score of the week. He even fixed both zeros. Rashee Rice came off the bench and scored 18.3, and there's an actual kicker in the lineup now. Harrison Butker, 6 points. It counts. At 2-6 he's one game behind Baker for the sixth and final playoff spot. He has avoided elimination. For now. Don't get excited. His parlay leg, Walker to score, missed. Walker carried it 21 times for 69 yards. Then, with under 15 seconds left, the Chiefs had the ball at the one. Fourth-and-goal. They gave it to Mahomes. Stuffed. Niko got 28.2 from Brock Bowers and 23.3 from Braelon Allen, then 4.88 from Aaron Rodgers and a zero from Tre Tucker. His Chiefs moneyline died on that same snap. It was the longest priced leg on the card at about -115, and the Chiefs led 24-13 after three quarters. One play, two dead legs. Rough day for Niko.

**BrekinBonez Jonez 148.40, Jaxon Smith My Njigba 130.96**
Josh Jacobs put up 23.2, Trevor Lawrence 19.4 and Dalton Kincaid 18.6. Two straight wins for Jones. Kuhlman got 26.56 from Josh Allen and 23.8 from Jaxon Smith-Njigba, which is what the team name promised. Both of their parlay legs hit. Kuhlman's Jags blew out the Colts. Jones took the Bills, and the Ravens lost Lamar Jackson on their first offensive snap and their backup in the second quarter. They finished with an undrafted rookie at quarterback. Bills 36-10. Jones picked the right week. Kuhlman's 130.96 is the most points in a loss this week. It would have beaten six teams. The Seahawks D/ST gave him 1 point. Parker Washington gave him 3.6. Back to .500.

**Aborted Conception 111.40, ILoveTeeSwift 107.58**
Schmuke started Lamar Jackson and got zero. Jackson hurt his thumb on the first snap and never recorded a stat. That's not a bad decision. That's a bad Sunday. Schmuke also started Will Reichard and got zero. That one's on him. Won anyway. 6-2. Tied for the best record in the league. Seventh in the power rankings. Chuba Hubbard (24.9), Matthew Golden (20.9) and Trey McBride (20.2) did the work. His "Brown 81.5+ total yards" leg also hit. A.J. Brown was ruled out before kickoff, so it was Chase Brown. The injury report answered the question for him. Andrew had the low score of the week. Tee Higgins went for 37.5 and D'Andre Swift for 27.9. Then Zay Flowers scored zero and Omar Cooper Jr. scored zero. Germie Bernard put up 8 on his bench. Put him at flex and Andrew wins 115.58 to 111.40. He keeps losing to the guy on his own bench. His Diggs 4+ receptions leg missed too. Diggs caught three passes. One of them was a touchdown. Didn't help. Three-game win streak over.

**Waddle you doing, step-Bo? 127.58, Nacuas With Attitude 126.94**
Closest game of the week, at 0.64. Same margin as last week's closest game. Somebody check the code. Jonah Coleman gave me 20.4, including the go-ahead touchdown in Denver after the two-minute warning. DJ Moore added 16.6. I also left Emmett Johnson's 25.3 on my bench and started KC Concepcion for 6.7. So yes, I'm the guy I make fun of every week. But I'm not the worst one here. Mike benched Tyler Allgeier. Allgeier scored 36.1. Xavier Worthy started at flex and scored 4.3. Make that swap and Mike wins by more than 31. Instead he lost by 0.64. Bhayshul Tuten (29.9), Patrick Mahomes (25.44) and Puka Nacua (25) all did their jobs. His Lawrence 200+ leg hit. That's his second hit of the season. Two straight losses. Normally I'd keep going. But Mike had a baby boy this week, which is the biggest win anyone in this league will have all year, and it isn't close. He had better things to do than check his bench. Congratulations, Mike. Welcome to the league, little man. Your dad's lineup decisions are not your fault.

## Power Rankings (The Short Version)

1. **Waddle you doing, step-Bo? (6-2), up 3**: First. Won by 0.64 with 25.3 on the bench. The formula doesn't watch the games.
2. **White Pollard (3-5), up 6**: Highest score of the week. Best recent form in the league. Losing record. Sure.
3. **Niko Dadfield (5-3), down 2**: All-play record of 48-24, best in the league. Started Aaron Rodgers anyway.
4. **Drake Baker (3-5), down 2**: Second in points for at 1115.12. 3-5. Fannin is on the bench, waiting.
5. **BrekinBonez Jonez (3-5), up 4**: Two straight wins. Took the Bills the week the Ravens ran out of quarterbacks.
6. **ILoveTeeSwift (5-3), down 3**: Two zeros in the lineup. Lost by 3.82. Do the math.
7. **Aborted Conception (6-2), down 1**: Zero at QB, zero at kicker, won. All-play record of 36-36. Perfectly average. 6-2.
8. **Jaxon Smith My Njigba (4-4), down 3**: All-play record of 43-29, third-best in the league. 4-4. Bad timing.
9. **Nacuas With Attitude (3-5), down 2**: Ninth in the rankings. First in the league in diapers. Congrats, Mike.
10. **Gloria Hole (2-6)**: Still last. But the streak is over and he's one game out. Small wins.

## Parlay Corner

Six of ten. Tied for our second-best week of the season. Still dead. We're 0-8. The misses: me, Andrew, Niko and Breezy. I took Irving 3+ receptions. The Bucs ran for 324 yards and beat Atlanta 16-0. Baker Mayfield went 0-for-3 passing. Three attempts. All day. Irving put up 21 fantasy points and I still lost the leg. That's not a bad beat. That's an anomaly. I'm 2-for-8 on the season, tied with Mike for the fewest hits. Baker and Jones lead the league at 6-for-8. Both are 3-5. One of them tried to bet against the Chiefs before settling on the Bills. Draw your own conclusions.

## Week 9: The One to Watch

White Pollard vs. BrekinBonez Jonez. Both 3-5. Both on two-game win streaks. Jas is second in the power rankings and Jones is fifth. Baker holds the last playoff spot at the same 3-5, on points. One of these streaks ends Sunday. Also worth a look: Aborted Conception vs. Nacuas With Attitude. Schmuke is 6-2 with an all-play record of 36-36. Mike just lost by 0.64 with 36.1 on his bench. If Mike sets his lineup correctly, the math finally catches up to Schmuke. With a newborn at home, that's a big if. Nobody would blame him.

MattyMo

title: Week 9 Preview: The Sunday Rundown
body:
Alright, Dads. Week 9. I'm sitting here with a beer at 10 in the morning because there's a football game in Madrid and that means it's technically afternoon somewhere, and I'm not going to apologize for it. Jaguars beat the Ravens 33-10 on Thursday, so some of you already have points. Bengals and Falcons are going right now in Spain, which is a sentence I hate typing. And somebody in this league is starting a wide receiver projected for zero. Again. We'll get there. We always get there.

## The Card

**Niko Dadfield (5-3) vs. Jaxon Smith My Njigba (4-4)**
Kuhlman is already up 19.68 to nothing thanks to Thursday: Parker Washington 14.1, Derrick Henry 5.58. Projected finish is Kuhlman 134.72, Niko 122.01. Niko is first in the league in points for at 1,116.56 and 48-24 in all-play, which is the best mark in the league, and he's getting projected out by almost 13 because his lineup is Amon-Ra (20.6), Brock Bowers (18.2) and then a bunch of guys you'd find at a waiver-wire garage sale. Also, history: Kuhlman beat Niko in the 2024 title game, 130.18 to 105.18, and leads the all-time series 4-1. Niko, I'm not saying you're cursed. I'm saying I'd be nervous.

**BrekinBonez Jonez (3-5) vs. White Pollard ✊🏻 (3-5)**
Jas is up 33.86 to 13.58 already. Joe Burrow has 21.86 and counting in Madrid, Jaguars D/ST put up 12 on Thursday, and all Jones has is Trevor Lawrence's 13.58. Projected: Jas 149.68, Jones 119.85. That's a 29.83-point gap, the biggest on the board, and a big chunk of it is self-inflicted (see Wall of Shame, bring a helmet). Jas is No. 2 in my power rankings at 3-5, which tells you everything about Jas's season: good team, bad luck, and I called it all along. Both guys are on two-game win streaks, and one of them ends today. All-time it's 5-4 Jones, and Jones won last year's meeting 146.94 to 117.82.

**Gloria Hole (2-6) vs. ILoveTeeSwift (5-3)**
Closest projected game of the week: Breezy 129.61, Andrew 126.73. Breezy, last place, 2-6, 21-51 in all-play, is projected to beat somebody. Don't get excited. Andrew leads 43.6 to 33.7 right now: Cam Little hit for 17 on Thursday, and Bijan (10.7) and Tee Higgins (10.6) are live in Spain. Breezy's got Ja'Marr Chase going nuclear for 28.2 live, plus Chase Brown 5.5. And here's the weird part: Breezy owns Andrew. 7-1 all-time, including a 159.92 to 82.06 playoff beatdown in 2023. Andrew's one win was last year, 111.6 to 93.36. Breezy coming off a 154.2 and a win. Is Breezy back? No. But he might be back for one Sunday.

**Drake Baker (3-5) vs. Waddle you doing, step-Bo? (6-2)**
MattyMo is the No. 1 team in my power rankings at 71.9 and projected at 150.32, the highest on the board, against Baker's 137.22. Baker leads 4.4 to 0 thanks to Drake London live in Madrid, which is the most Baker thing possible: up early, losing late. Baker is second in the league in points for at 1,115.12 and somehow 3-5, so he's not really 3-5, he's like 5-3 in spirit. Doesn't matter. MattyMo leads the all-time series 8-1 and knocked Baker out of the playoffs last year, 135.7 to 125.9. This isn't a rivalry, it's a hostage situation.

**Unaborted Concepcion (6-2) vs. Nacuas With Attitude (3-5)**
Mike is up 8.9 to 0 on Bhayshul Tuten's Thursday. Projected: Schmuke 140.25, Mike 132.65. Schmuke is 6-2 and I'll get to why that's fake in a minute. Mike is on a two-game losing streak, 25-47 in all-play, and has Puka (24.23) and Nabers (17.06) to drag him to a respectable loss. Mike leads the series 4-1, but Schmuke won last year by 0.86 of a point, 136.1 to 135.24, which is the Schmuke experience in one number.

## Early Leads

1. **Kuhlman** +19.68 over Niko, all Thursday: Parker Washington 14.1, Derrick Henry 5.58. Niko has nothing on the board.
2. **Jas** +20.28 over Jones: Joe Burrow 21.86 (live), Jaguars D/ST 12. Jones has Trevor Lawrence's 13.58.
3. **Andrew** +9.9 over Breezy, 43.6 to 33.7: Cam Little 17, Bijan Robinson 10.7 (live), Tee Higgins 10.6 (live), Zay Flowers 5.3. Breezy has Ja'Marr Chase 28.2 (live) and Chase Brown 5.5 (live).
4. **Mike** +8.9 over Schmuke: Bhayshul Tuten 8.9 on Thursday.
5. **Baker** +4.4 over MattyMo: Drake London 4.4 (live).

Congrats to the leaders. Enjoy it. It's a long Sunday and I've watched a lot of leads die. I'm a Bears fan, I've watched every lead die.

## Matchups to Watch

1. **Breezy vs. Andrew** — 2.88 points projected. Last place vs. third place, and last place owns the series 7-1. Chase already has 28.2 and it's still the first half in Madrid.
2. **Schmuke vs. Mike** — 7.6 projected. The 6-2 fraud vs. the 3-5 guy who scores about the same. Last year it came down to 0.86.
3. **Kuhlman vs. Niko** — 12.71 projected, title-game rematch, and Kuhlman is already up 19.68. Niko needs his garage-sale guys to show up.

## Hot Seat

Six teams make it, 14 regular-season weeks, six games left including today. Nobody is eliminated, nobody gets eliminated with a loss today, and nobody is two games out. The last playoff spot belongs to Baker at 3-5 on points for, with Jas, Jones and Mike all sitting at 3-5 right next to him (ties are still alive, points for breaks them). So it's too early to panic. Breezy, panic anyway. You're 2-6, one game behind that 3-5 pile, last in points for at 940.12, and the next loss puts you in real "well, there's always next year" territory. I know that feeling. I've lived in it my whole life.

## Parlay Watch

All 10 legs in, all 10 with odds. Ranked safest to longest:

1. **Kuhlman** — Chiefs ML (-458) vs. Jets. LOCK. It's -458. If this misses, we go outside and yell at the sky together.
2. **Schmuke** — Saints ML (-159) vs. Browns. STAY AWAY. Shaky bet: Schmuke starts Denzel Boston and KC Concepcion, both Browns. He's rooting for his own receivers' team to lose. That's a man at war with himself.
3. **Andrew** — D'Andre Swift 10+ rec yds (-140). LOCK. His own guy, low bar. Fine.
4. **Jones** — Bears ML (-140) vs. Bucs. WHAT ARE WE DOING. I'm a Chicago guy. Never trust the Bears in a primetime game. Never.
5. **Baker** — Raiders +9.5 (-106) at 49ers. STAY AWAY. You're taking the Raiders on purpose.
6. **MattyMo** — Justin Jefferson 6.5+ rec (-104). WHAT ARE WE DOING. Shaky bet: Jefferson is on Baker's team, and Baker is MattyMo's opponent today. You're paying money to root for the other guy's WR1. Also MattyMo is 2-6 on the season in the parlay, worst in the league. Great fantasy team, horrible gambler. Classic.
7. **Jas** — Jahmyr Gibbs 60+ rush yds (-103). LOCK. His own guy, best RB projection on the board at 26.54.
8. **Niko** — Lions ML (-103) at Dolphins. LOCK-ish. Niko's 4-4 on the year, the most .500 man alive.
9. **Mike** — Jared Goff 1.5+ pass TDs (-103). STAY AWAY. Mike is 2-5 on the season. I'm not betting with Mike.
10. **Breezy** — Commanders +4.5 (-101) vs. Rams. **Longshot of the week**, which this week means a coin flip. Breezy's 3-5 on the season. Of course it's Breezy.

No international legs (nobody touched Madrid, good, stay away from international games), nobody fading the Chiefs, no long underdogs. The only real shaky ones are MattyMo's Jefferson and Schmuke's Saints. It's not hitting. But I'll be watching.

Season parlay records to be ashamed of: MattyMo 2-6, Mike 2-5, Jas 3-5, Breezy 3-5. Baker and Jones lead the way at 6-2, which proves gambling skill and fantasy skill have nothing to do with each other.

## Wall of Shame

**Starting a zero.** Jones. JONES. Garrett Wilson is in your WR slot projected for ZERO, and the Jets are playing today, at Arrowhead. Meanwhile Keenan Allen is on your bench projected for 10.17. You're already down 29.83 projected to Jas, the biggest hole on the board, and you're choosing to play with nine guys. Every other starting WR in this league is projected for something. Wilson is projected for nothing. Fix it before 1:00 Eastern. Actually, you know what, it's fine. Relax. It's actually a great strategy. No it isn't. Fix it.

**No pick.** Everybody turned in a pick this week. All 10. I don't know who you people are anymore. I'm almost disappointed.

## Fraud Alert

Schmuke. 6-2, tied for first, and seventh in points for at 1,020.3. 36-36 in all-play, which means if he played everyone every week he'd be dead even. Seventh in my power rankings at 45.6. Two of those six wins came by 0.6 over Jas and 3.82 over Andrew. This is a fraud. I'm not mad, I'm just telling you. Enjoy the ride, Schmuke. It's ending. I've been saying it the whole time.

Big Dad Energy

title: Week 9 Recap
body:
Greetings fellow Dads,

Nine weeks in. I'm 7-2. I have the fewest points against in the league at 1044.16. I dropped from first to third in the power rankings after a win. The formula finally started watching the games.

Meanwhile Schmuke went from seventh to first. Yes, that Schmuke. Three straight Sunday Rundowns called him a fraud. He scored 180.38 and the math caught up with him, just not the way we promised.

Let's get into it.

## The Games

**Aborted Conception 180.38, Nacuas With Attitude 110.18**
High score of the week, and the biggest blowout at +70.20. Jordan Love put up 36.18. Matthew Golden added 32.4. Then KC Concepcion went for 18.8. That's the same KC Concepcion I started last week for 6.7. Glad he found a good home. Ka'imi Fairbairn kicked in 17, which is 17 more than Schmuke's kicker gave him last week. His Saints moneyline hit too, 23-22 in overtime over Cleveland. That's how a 7-2 team wins: barely, and in a way nobody should feel good about. Mike got 35 from Puka Nacua, the most points by any player in a loss this week. Then George Pickens scored zero at flex while Xavier Worthy put up 10.8 on his bench. It wouldn't have mattered.
